name: マルコフ遷移分析
description: Analyzes inter-pixel transition probabilities using Markov chain models. AI images show different transition patterns compared to natural photographs.
algorithm: First-order Markov Chain + Transition Matrix Analysis
mechanism: Builds transition probability matrix from adjacent pixel differences. Entropy and transition patterns differ between AI and real images.
parameters: States: quantized gradient levels, Direction: horizontal
useCase: Analyzing pixel transition patterns for AI detection

references.title: Shi, Y.Q. et al. (2006). A Markov Process Based Approach to Effective Attacking JPEG Steganography. IHMSP.
Sullivan, K. et al. (2006). Steganalysis with Image Quality Metrics. IEEE TIFS.
Fridrich, J. (2009). Steganography in Digital Media. Cambridge University Press.

strengths:
• Captures pixel transition dependencies effectively
• Models natural image statistics rigorously
• Sensitive to subtle smoothing and processing
• Works in both spatial and transform domains
• Proven effective in steganalysis research
limitations:
• Transition matrix can be large and sparse
• Limited to first-order dependencies in basic form
• Quantization of pixel values affects precision
• Computationally expensive for dense matrices
• Some AI models produce natural transition patterns
